title: Pakistan Maritime Shipping Regulation And Control Repeal Act 1991

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Maritime Shipping Regulation And Control Repeal Act 1991
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XIX OF 1991
ACT XIX OF 1991
PAKISTAN MARITIME
SHIPPING (REGULATION AND CONTROL) (REPEAL) ACT, 1991
Apt Act to repeal
the Pakistan Maritime Shipping (Regulation and Control) Act, 1974
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th November, 1991]
Whereas it is expedient to repeal
the Pakistan Maritime Shipping (Regulation and Control) Act, 1974.
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Pakistan Maritime Shipping
(Regulation and Control) (Repeal) Act, 1991.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
